entries.descriptionOriginal: UNBOXING SIMULATOR A Roblox-style crate breaking simulator, built entirely inside Counter-Strike 2. Break crates, earn coins, hatch pets, collect hats, unlock new zones and climb the leaderboard! FEATURES 57 zones – every zone has stronger crates and bigger rewards. Unlock the next one with coins. 19 knives – buy better knives in the weapon shops to break crates faster. Pets – hatch eggs and get pets that boost your coins. Rarities go up to Legendary, plus Golden and Rainbow versions. Merge duplicates to make them stronger. Hats – rare drops that boost your damage. Upgrades – damage, attack speed, coins, critical hits, gems and luck. Special crates – gem crates, rainbow crates and boss crates. Potions – temporary boosts for coins, luck and more. Rebirth – start over with permanent bonuses. Daily rewards, quests, lucky wheel and timed chests Trading – trade pets and hats with other players. Leaderboards – "This session" and "All time" boards in the hub. Secret cards – hidden cards are scattered around the map. Find one, solve its puzzle and redeem the code for a reward! Music player – copyright-free soundtrack by default (safe for streaming), with an optional popular song list. Camera modes – first person, follow camera and fixed (top-down) camera with zoom. Progress is saved automatically 8 languages: English, Türkçe, Русский, 中文, Italiano, Français, Português, Polski HOW TO PLAY Walk up to a crate and hold LEFT CLICK to break it. Press E to interact (eggs, chests, shops, secret cards). Use the buttons on the right side of the screen for inventory, upgrades, rebirth, teleport, trading, codes and language. Unlock the next zone at the gate when you have enough coins. CHAT COMMANDS Almost everything has a button on screen. Only these are chat commands: CommandWhat it does /leaderboardShows the full all-time ranking of every player !stuckTeleports you back to the hub if you get stuck (10 s cooldown) !saveOpens the save transfer window (export / import) !resetResets ALL of your own progress (asks for confirmation) !commandsShows the command list SAVES Your progress is saved automatically on the server you play on. To move your progress to another server, use !save → export on the old server, then paste the !import lines on the new one. SECRET CARDS Golden cards with a question mark are hidden around the map. Get close and press E to read the hint, solve it, then type the code in the CODES menu. Each code works once per player. More cards are coming soon! CREDITS Map, scripts, models and musics by Bugimm. Copyright-free music made for this map. Check out CyberRulz TV on YouTube!
